description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirement Your marked target is below half its maximum Hit Points.

You have marked exactly one person at a time for two decades, and not one of them is still standing.

Make a melee Strike against your mark. It automatically hits, is a critical hit, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your Class DC or die. On a success it instead takes the critical damage and is doomed 2. A creature that survives this cannot be targeted by it again for a year.

cinderfall.incomplete: A melee Strike against a below-half-HP mark auto-hits, auto-crits, and forces a Fortitude save vs. Class DC or death (success: critical damage plus doomed 2). No rule element guarantees an outright hit/crit, and no rule element applies doomed or forces death on a different creature -- independent of the mark-predicate gap.
